confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on aggregated cost-of-living sites (Numbeo, WhereAndWhen, Wise, combien-coute.net) and on Himara benchmarks for cocktails and wine, since no Saranda-specific cocktail or wine price was found. Beer and wine ranges come from secondary guides, and the Tirana beer price could not be confirmed. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. The FX rate is from a secondary site that reads the RBA feed for 18 Nov 2026; it was not confirmed against the full RBA F11 table. Summer-season hotel pricing on the coast may run above these anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Albanian Riviera and southern Albanian coastal price levels, cross-checked against Himara guide prices and Albania-wide restaurant averages from Numbeo and similar aggregators. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a mid-sized Albanian seaside resort town with seasonal demand.
